rules.baseline: Original: enter while completed WT1 > WT2; exit on any confirmed red crossover.
rules.oversold_entry: Oversold entry: enter only on a new confirmed green cross with WT1 ≤ -45; exit on any confirmed red crossover.
rules.atr_exit: ATR exit: original entries; exit on any red cross OR completed-close ATR trailing breach.
rules.oversold_and_atr: Combined: oversold entries; exit on any red cross OR completed-close ATR trailing breach.

buyAndHold.costConvention: Same inherited starting shares; no trades or forced sale, so no transaction costs.
